seo.title: Rise & Read 2027 — 21-Day Reading-Habit Challenge
seo.description: Swap 20 minutes of reels for 20 pages a day. Rise & Read 2027 is a 21-day reading-habit challenge by Habit Rise, starting 1 January 2027. Students get a special price.

hero.text: Rise & Read 2027 is a 21-day reading-habit challenge. Read daily, apply one idea a week, and finally finish the books you keep buying.

card.title: Today's reading
card.takeaway: Small habits compound. Start smaller than feels useful.

problem.text: You open your phone for one minute and lose an hour. The books you bought are still on the shelf.
problem.highlight: It isn't a discipline problem. It's a system problem, and systems can be built.

steps.title: Set your goal
steps.text: Free goal-setting and vision board session before 1 January.

steps.title: Read 20 minutes a day
steps.text: Paper or Kindle, phone away. Check in daily on WhatsApp.

steps.title: Share one takeaway
steps.text: One line a day. Short, honest, no essays.

steps.title: Apply one idea a week
steps.text: Turn what you read into one action in your life.

includes.title: Everything you need to finish the book.
items: A 21-day guided reading plan for one self-help book
A reading buddy to keep you accountable
3 weekly live sessions with Manikandan, habit coach
Goal-setting and vision board workshop (from Habit Rise)
"Restart, don't quit" rule: miss a day, you don't lose your place

items.title: Students
items.text: Build focus and a reading habit before placements and exams.

items.title: Working professionals
items.text: Get your evenings back from the screen and grow on purpose.

plans.name: Student
plans.who: Use code STUDENT or your college's code

plans.name: Professional

coach.title: Hi, I'm Mani 👋
coach.text: Manikandan Rajendran is a habit coach and founder of Habit Rise. He has trained 5,000+ students on habits and employability, and has spent 12+ years in banking technology leadership. He built Rise & Read for one reason: to help the next generation trade the scroll for growth.
coach.photoAlt: Manikandan Rajendran, habit coach and founder of Habit Rise

items.q: Do I need to buy the book?
items.a: Yes. Paper or Kindle. We'll share where to get it.
20 minutes of reading plus 2 minutes to check in.

items.q: What if I miss a day?
items.a: Restart the next day. No penalty, no shame.
Sessions are in English with Tamil support.
Continue to the next book cohort, or join Habit Rise coaching to go deeper.
